Baba Ramdev – once known as India’s yoga guru, now a business tycoon and political influencer whose reach extends far beyond the yoga mat. This video explores the fascinating yet controversial journey of Baba Ramdev, from teaching early morning yoga on TV to becoming a powerful figure in the political, economic, and spiritual arenas of India.

Born as Ram Kishan Yadav in Haryana, Ramdev rose from humble beginnings, with early struggles including partial facial paralysis, to establishing a vast empire under the banner of Patanjali Ayurved. From Ayurvedic medicines to FMCG products and even data services, Ramdev’s brand now penetrates almost every Indian household. But behind this meteoric rise lies a trail of controversies — from misleading advertisements, substandard products failing quality tests, exploitation of religious sentiments, to making false claims about curing serious diseases like diabetes, asthma, and even COVID-19.

The video also investigates Baba Ramdev’s deep political connections, especially his role in mobilizing public opinion against the UPA government during the anti-corruption movement, and his close alignment with the Narendra Modi-led BJP. Despite repeated warnings and penalties from the Supreme Court and regulatory authorities, his misleading promotions and aggressive market strategies continue unchecked.

Through this in-depth exposé, we question whether Baba Ramdev is still a spiritual guru, or has he transformed into one of the shrewdest businessmen and political brokers of modern India, using faith, fear, and nationalism as his most potent business tools
